ko.title: [국제물류 #10] 계약 하나, 운송수단 네 가지: 포워더는 화물을 어떻게 문 앞까지 옮기나

segments.src: > When cargo travels by truck, ship, and train, multimodal transport lets one company take responsibility for the whole trip under one contract and one transport document. Freight forwarders usually organize that trip.
segments.tr: > 화물이 트럭, 선박, 기차로 이동할 때, 복합운송은 한 회사가 하나의 계약과 하나의 운송서류로 전체 운송 구간의 책임을 지도록 합니다. 보통 프레이트 포워더가 이 운송을 조직합니다.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 오늘의 개념

segments.src: Most international shipments don't travel by just one vehicle.
segments.tr: 대부분의 국제 화물은 한 가지 운송수단만으로 이동하지 않습니다.

segments.src: A container might leave a factory on a truck, cross an ocean on a ship, move inland by train, and reach its destination on another truck.
segments.tr: 컨테이너는 공장에서 트럭에 실려 출발해, 선박으로 바다를 건너고, 철도로 내륙을 이동한 뒤, 다른 트럭에 실려 목적지에 도착할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: This is called **multimodal transport** (also called *combined* or *intermodal* transport): moving goods by **at least two different modes of transport under a single contract**.
segments.tr: 이것을 **복합운송**(*결합운송* 또는 *복합일관운송*이라고도 함)이라고 합니다. 즉 **단일 계약 아래 최소 두 가지 이상의 서로 다른 운송수단으로** 화물을 옮기는 것입니다.

segments.src: That last part is what matters.
segments.tr: 여기서 중요한 부분은 마지막 조건입니다.

segments.src: Without it, a shipper would have to sign separate contracts with a trucking company, an ocean carrier, a railroad, and a local delivery firm.
segments.tr: 그 조건이 없다면 화주는 트럭 회사, 해상 운송인, 철도 회사, 현지 배송업체와 각각 별도의 계약을 맺어야 합니다.

segments.src: Then, if something went wrong, they would have to work out which company was responsible.
segments.tr: 그러다 문제가 생기면 어느 회사가 책임질지 따져야 합니다.

segments.src: Multimodal transport replaces that patchwork with **one party responsible for the whole journey**: the **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: 복합운송은 이런 짜깁기 구조를 **전 구간에 책임지는 한 당사자**, 즉 **복합운송인(MTO, Multimodal Transport Operator)**으로 대체합니다.

segments.src: The MTO issues a **multimodal (or combined) transport document**, often in the form of a bill of lading.
segments.tr: MTO는 보통 선하증권 형태의 **복합운송서류**(또는 결합운송서류)를 발행합니다.

segments.src: A well-known standard version is the **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, published by the international federation of freight forwarders.
segments.tr: 잘 알려진 표준 양식은 국제 포워더 연맹이 발행하는 **FIATA 복합운송 선하증권(FBL)**입니다.

segments.src: Like an ordinary ocean bill of lading, it can serve as:
segments.tr: 일반 해상 선하증권과 마찬가지로 다음 역할을 할 수 있습니다:

segments.src: 1. **A receipt** showing that the goods were taken in charge,
segments.tr: 1. **수령증**: 화물을 인수했음을 증명,

segments.src: 2. **Evidence of the contract** of carriage, and
segments.tr: 2. **운송계약의 증거**, 그리고

segments.src: 3. In its negotiable form, **a document of title**, which banks rely on in trade finance such as letters of credit.
segments.tr: 3. 유통성(negotiable) 형태일 경우 **권리증권**. 신용장 같은 무역금융에서 은행이 이에 의존합니다.

segments.src: The main difference is coverage.
segments.tr: 가장 큰 차이는 적용 범위입니다.

segments.src: An ocean bill of lading usually runs from port to port.
segments.tr: 해상 선하증권은 보통 항구에서 항구까지입니다.

segments.src: A multimodal document can run from the **place of receipt** (say, an inland factory) to the **place of delivery** (say, an inland warehouse).
segments.tr: 복합운송서류는 **수령지**(예: 내륙 공장)에서 **인도지**(예: 내륙 창고)까지 다룰 수 있습니다.

segments.src: So who acts as the MTO?
segments.tr: 그렇다면 누가 MTO 역할을 할까요?

segments.src: Often it's a **freight forwarder**.
segments.tr: 보통 **프레이트 포워더**가 그 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: A forwarder is a logistics specialist that arranges shipments for customers.
segments.tr: 포워더는 고객을 위해 선적을 주선하는 물류 전문 업체입니다.

segments.src: Forwarders can play two different roles:
segments.tr: 포워더는 두 가지 다른 역할을 맡을 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **As an agent:** The forwarder books space with carriers *on your behalf*. It handles paperwork and coordination, but the carriers remain responsible for the actual transport.
segments.tr: - **대리인으로서:** 포워더는 *고객을 대신해* 운송업체와 선복을 예약합니다. 서류 작업과 조율을 처리하지만, 실제 운송에 대한 책임은 운송업체에 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: - **As a principal (carrier):** The forwarder issues its *own* transport document and takes on carrier-style responsibility, even though it may not own a single ship or truck. In U.S. ocean shipping, this kind of company is called an **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).
segments.tr: - **본인(운송인)으로서:** 포워더는 *자기 명의의* 운송서류를 발행하고, 선박이나 트럭을 한 대도 소유하지 않더라도 운송인과 같은 책임을 집니다. 미국 해상운송에서는 이런 업체를 **NVOCC**(Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier, 무선박 공동운송인)라고 부릅니다.

segments.src: This difference has real consequences.
segments.tr: 이 차이는 실제 결과로 이어집니다.

segments.src: If cargo is damaged, the role the forwarder played determines who you file a claim against.
segments.tr: 화물이 파손되면, 포워더가 맡은 역할에 따라 누구에게 청구해야 하는지가 정해집니다.

segments.src: In practice, an MTO's liability can also depend on *where* the damage happened, because the rules for the ocean leg and the trucking leg may differ.
segments.tr: 실제로는 해상 구간과 트럭 구간의 법규가 다를 수 있으므로, MTO의 책임은 손해가 *어디서* 발생했는지에 따라서도 달라질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Contracts spell this out, so it pays to read the terms.
segments.tr: 계약서에 이런 내용이 명시되므로 약관을 꼼꼼히 읽을 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: Forwarders also tend to offer related services: consolidating small shipments into shared containers, arranging cargo insurance, preparing documents, and coordinating with customs brokers.
segments.tr: 포워더는 관련 서비스도 함께 제공하는 경우가 많습니다. 소량 화물을 공동 컨테이너로 묶는 혼재(consolidation), 화물보험 가입, 서류 작성, 관세사와의 업무 조율 등이 그것입니다.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 일상 속에서

segments.src: Picture Maya, who owns a small furniture store in **Columbus, Ohio**.
segments.tr: **미국 오하이오주 컬럼버스**에서 작은 가구점을 운영하는 Maya를 떠올려 봅시다.

segments.src: She orders a 40-foot container of wooden dining sets from a manufacturer near **Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam**.
segments.tr: 그녀는 **베트남 호찌민시** 인근 제조업체에 나무 식탁 세트를 담은 40피트 컨테이너를 주문합니다.

segments.src: Columbus has no seaport, and Maya has no time to manage four carriers.
segments.tr: 컬럼버스에는 항구가 없고, Maya에게는 운송업체 네 곳을 관리할 시간이 없습니다.

segments.src: So she hires a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: 그래서 그녀는 프레이트 포워더를 고용합니다.

segments.src: Here's the journey:
segments.tr: 운송 경로는 다음과 같습니다:

segments.src: 1. **Truck:** Factory → Cat Lai port in Ho Chi Minh City
segments.tr: 1. **트럭:** 공장 → 호찌민시의 Cat Lai 항

segments.src: 2. **Ship:** Vietnam → Port of Los Angeles / Long Beach
segments.tr: 2. **선박:** 베트남 → 로스앤젤레스 / 롱비치 항

segments.src: 3. **Rail:** Southern California → an inland rail ramp in the Midwest
segments.tr: 3. **철도:** 남부 캘리포니아 → 중서부 내륙의 철도 적하장

segments.src: 4. **Truck:** Rail ramp → Maya's warehouse in Columbus
segments.tr: 4. **트럭:** 철도 적하장 → 컬럼버스의 Maya 창고

segments.src: The forwarder, acting as an NVOCC, issues **one bill of lading covering "place of receipt: factory" to "place of delivery: Columbus."** Maya pays one freight bill in U.S.
segments.tr: NVOCC로 행동하는 포워더는 **"수령지: 공장"에서 "인도지: 컬럼버스"까지를 다루는 선하증권 한 장**을 발행합니다. Maya는 운임 청구서 한 장을 미국

segments.src: dollars, say a quoted all-in rate for the container, and deals with one point of contact.
segments.tr: 달러로 결제합니다. 예를 들어 컨테이너당 제시된 올인(all-in) 운임이며, 연락 창구도 한 곳으로 단일화됩니다.

segments.src: If a few chairs arrive cracked, she starts her claim with the forwarder instead of trying to figure out whether the ship, the train, or the truck caused it.
segments.tr: 의자 몇 개가 깨진 채 도착하면, 그녀는 선박, 기차, 트럭 중 무엇이 손상을 일으켰는지 따지는 대신 포워더에게 먼저 클레임을 제기합니다.

segments.src: Customs clearance is a separate job handled by a **licensed customs broker**.
segments.tr: 통관은 별도의 업무로, **면허를 받은 관세사**가 담당합니다.

segments.src: Many forwarders have one in-house or work with one as a partner.
segments.tr: 많은 포워더는 사내에 관세사를 두거나 파트너 관세사와 협력합니다.

segments.src: In the U.S., NVOCCs are licensed or registered by the **Federal Maritime Commission (FMC)**.
segments.tr: 미국에서는 NVOCC가 **연방해사위원회(FMC)**의 면허를 받거나 등록합니다.

segments.src: Customs brokers are licensed by **U.S.
segments.tr: 관세사는 **미국

segments.src: Customs and Border Protection (CBP)**.
segments.tr: 세관국경보호국(CBP)**의 면허를 받습니다.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3줄 요약

segments.src: - **Multimodal transport** uses two or more modes (truck, ship, rail, air) under **one contract** with **one responsible operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: - **복합운송**은 **하나의 계약**과 **하나의 책임 운송인(MTO)** 아래 두 가지 이상의 운송수단(트럭, 선박, 철도, 항공)을 사용합니다.

segments.src: - A **multimodal transport document** (e.g., FIATA FBL) can cover cargo door to door and, when negotiable, works as a receipt, contract evidence, and document of title.
segments.tr: - **복합운송서류**(예: FIATA FBL)는 화물을 문 앞까지 다룰 수 있으며, 유통성이 있을 경우 수령증, 계약 증거, 권리증권 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: - A **freight forwarder** may act as an **agent** (arranging transport for you) or as a **principal/NVOCC** (taking carrier responsibility), and that role decides who is liable.
segments.tr: - **프레이트 포워더**는 **대리인**(고객을 위해 운송 주선) 또는 **본인/NVOCC**(운송인 책임 수행)로 행동할 수 있으며, 그 역할이 누가 책임을 지는지를 결정합니다.

segments.src: ## ✅ Self-Quiz
segments.tr: ## ✅ 자가 점검

segments.src: **Q1.** What defines multimodal transport?
segments.tr: **Q1.** 복합운송을 정의하는 것은 무엇입니까?

segments.src: - A) Using only containers
segments.tr: - A) 컨테이너만 사용하는 것

segments.src: - B) Using at least two modes of transport under a single contract
segments.tr: - B) 단일 계약 아래 최소 두 가지 이상의 운송수단을 사용하는 것

segments.src: - C) Shipping goods to more than one country
segments.tr: - C) 두 개 이상의 국가로 화물을 보내는 것

segments.src: - D) Using the fastest available carrier
segments.tr: - D) 이용 가능한 가장 빠른 운송업체를 쓰는 것

segments.src: (True/False)** A company must own ships to issue its own ocean bill of lading as a carrier in U.S.
segments.tr: (참/거짓)** 미국 무역에서 운송인으로서 자기 명의의 해상 선하증권을 발행하려면

segments.src: trade.
segments.tr: 회사가 반드시 선박을 소유해야 한다.

segments.src: **Q3.** A forwarder books space with an ocean carrier on the shipper's behalf and does not issue its own bill of lading.
segments.tr: **Q3.** 포워더가 화주를 대신해 해상 운송업체와 선복을 예약하고 자기 명의의 선하증권은 발행하지 않습니다.

segments.src: In this case, the forwarder is acting as:
segments.tr: 이 경우 포워더는 어떤 역할을 하는 것입니까?

segments.src: - A) A principal
segments.tr: - A) 본인(principal)

segments.src: - B) An NVOCC
segments.tr: - B) NVOCC

segments.src: - C) An agent
segments.tr: - C) 대리인

segments.src: - D) A customs broker
segments.tr: - D) 관세사

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 오늘의 용어

segments.src: - **Multimodal Transport:** Moving goods by two or more modes of transport under one contract.
segments.tr: - **복합운송(Multimodal Transport):** 단일 계약 아래 두 가지 이상의 운송수단으로 화물을 옮기는 것.

segments.src: - **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO):** The party that signs the multimodal contract and takes responsibility for the entire journey.
segments.tr: - **복합운송인(MTO, Multimodal Transport Operator):** 복합운송 계약을 체결하고 전체 운송 구간에 대한 책임을 지는 당사자.

segments.src: - **Multimodal (Combined) Transport Bill of Lading:** A transport document covering the whole multimodal route, often from inland origin to inland destination.
segments.tr: - **복합(결합)운송 선하증권(Multimodal (Combined) Transport Bill of Lading):** 복합운송 경로 전체를 다루는 운송서류로, 보통 내륙 출발지에서 내륙 목적지까지 포함합니다.

segments.src: - **Freight Forwarder:** A logistics intermediary that arranges shipments and related services, acting as either an agent or a principal.
segments.tr: - **프레이트 포워더(Freight Forwarder):** 선적과 관련 서비스를 주선하는 물류 중개업체로, 대리인 또는 본인 중 하나의 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: - **NVOCC:** A company that acts as an ocean carrier toward shippers, issuing its own bills of lading, without operating vessels.
segments.tr: - **NVOCC:** 선박을 운항하지 않으면서 자기 명의의 선하증권을 발행하고 화주에게 해상 운송인으로 행동하는 업체.

segments.src: *Answers: Q1 – B.
segments.tr: *정답: Q1 – B.

segments.src: What makes it "multimodal" is the mix of modes under a single contract, not the type of container or the number of countries.
segments.tr: '복합'을 만드는 것은 컨테이너 종류나 국가 수가 아니라, 단일 계약 아래 여러 운송수단을 함께 쓰는 것입니다.

segments.src: Q2 – False.
segments.tr: Q2 – 거짓.

segments.src: NVOCCs issue their own bills of lading and take carrier responsibility without operating any vessels; they buy space from vessel operators.
segments.tr: NVOCC는 선박을 운영하지 않고도 자기 명의의 선하증권을 발행하고 운송인 책임을 집니다. 선박 운영자로부터 선복을 구입합니다.

segments.src: Q3 – C.
segments.tr: Q3 – C.

segments.src: Arranging transport on the shipper's behalf without taking carrier responsibility is the agent role.
segments.tr: 화주를 대신해 운송을 주선하면서 운송인 책임은 지지 않는 것이 대리인 역할입니다.

segments.src: Customs brokers handle customs clearance, which is a separate function.*
segments.tr: 관세사는 통관을 담당하며, 이는 별도의 기능입니다.*

zh.title: [国际物流 #10] 一份合同，四种运输方式：货运代理如何实现门到门运输

segments.src: > When cargo travels by truck, ship, and train, multimodal transport lets one company take responsibility for the whole trip under one contract and one transport document. Freight forwarders usually organize that trip.
segments.tr: > 当货物通过卡车、船舶和火车运输时，多式联运让一家公司在一份合同和一份运输单据之下，对整个运程承担责任。货运代理通常负责组织这一运程。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 今日概念

segments.src: Most international shipments don't travel by just one vehicle.
segments.tr: 大多数国际货运并非只通过一种运输工具完成。

segments.src: A container might leave a factory on a truck, cross an ocean on a ship, move inland by train, and reach its destination on another truck.
segments.tr: 一个集装箱可能先由卡车从工厂运出，再由船舶跨越海洋，然后经铁路运至内陆，最后由另一辆卡车送达目的地。

segments.src: This is called **multimodal transport** (also called *combined* or *intermodal* transport): moving goods by **at least two different modes of transport under a single contract**.
segments.tr: 这被称为**多式联运**（也称为*联合运输*或*复合运输*）：在**单一合同之下**，使用**至少两种不同的运输方式**运送货物。

segments.src: That last part is what matters.
segments.tr: 关键在于最后这一点。

segments.src: Without it, a shipper would have to sign separate contracts with a trucking company, an ocean carrier, a railroad, and a local delivery firm.
segments.tr: 如果没有这一点，托运人就必须分别与卡车运输公司、海运承运人、铁路公司和当地配送公司签订多份合同。

segments.src: Then, if something went wrong, they would have to work out which company was responsible.
segments.tr: 一旦出现问题，他们还得自己查明应由哪家公司负责。

segments.src: Multimodal transport replaces that patchwork with **one party responsible for the whole journey**: the **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: 多式联运以一种模式取代了这种碎片化安排：由**一方对整个运程负责**，即**多式联运经营人（MTO）**。

segments.src: The MTO issues a **multimodal (or combined) transport document**, often in the form of a bill of lading.
segments.tr: MTO 会签发**多式联运（或联合运输）单据**，通常采用提单的形式。

segments.src: A well-known standard version is the **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, published by the international federation of freight forwarders.
segments.tr: 一种广为人知的标准版本是**FIATA多式联运提单（FBL）**，由国际货运代理协会联合会发布。

segments.src: Like an ordinary ocean bill of lading, it can serve as:
segments.tr: 与普通海运提单一样，它可以作为：

segments.src: 1. **A receipt** showing that the goods were taken in charge,
segments.tr: 1. **收据**，证明货物已被接收照管；

segments.src: 2. **Evidence of the contract** of carriage, and
segments.tr: 2. **运输合同的证明**；以及

segments.src: 3. In its negotiable form, **a document of title**, which banks rely on in trade finance such as letters of credit.
segments.tr: 3. 在其可转让形式下，作为**物权凭证**，银行在信用证等贸易融资中依赖它。

segments.src: The main difference is coverage.
segments.tr: 主要区别在于承保范围。

segments.src: An ocean bill of lading usually runs from port to port.
segments.tr: 海运提单通常是港到港。

segments.src: A multimodal document can run from the **place of receipt** (say, an inland factory) to the **place of delivery** (say, an inland warehouse).
segments.tr: 多式联运单据则可以从**接收地**（比如内陆工厂）运至**交付地**（比如内陆仓库）。

segments.src: So who acts as the MTO?
segments.tr: 那么，谁来担任MTO？

segments.src: Often it's a **freight forwarder**.
segments.tr: 通常是**货运代理**。

segments.src: A forwarder is a logistics specialist that arranges shipments for customers.
segments.tr: 货运代理是一种物流专业服务商，为客户安排货物运输。

segments.src: Forwarders can play two different roles:
segments.tr: 货运代理可以扮演两种不同的角色：

segments.src: - **As an agent:** The forwarder books space with carriers *on your behalf*. It handles paperwork and coordination, but the carriers remain responsible for the actual transport.
segments.tr: - **作为代理人：** 货运代理*代表您*向承运人订舱。它负责单证和协调工作，但实际运输仍由承运人负责。

segments.src: - **As a principal (carrier):** The forwarder issues its *own* transport document and takes on carrier-style responsibility, even though it may not own a single ship or truck. In U.S. ocean shipping, this kind of company is called an **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).
segments.tr: - **作为委托人（承运人）：** 货运代理签发*自己的*运输单据，并承担类似承运人的责任，即使它可能并不拥有任何一艘船或一辆卡车。在美国海运中，这类公司被称为**NVOCC**（无船承运人）。

segments.src: This difference has real consequences.
segments.tr: 这一区别会带来实际后果。

segments.src: If cargo is damaged, the role the forwarder played determines who you file a claim against.
segments.tr: 如果货物受损，货运代理所扮演的角色决定了您应向谁提出索赔。

segments.src: In practice, an MTO's liability can also depend on *where* the damage happened, because the rules for the ocean leg and the trucking leg may differ.
segments.tr: 实际上，MTO的责任还可能取决于损失*发生的地点*，因为海运段和陆运段适用的规则可能不同。

segments.src: Contracts spell this out, so it pays to read the terms.
segments.tr: 合同会对此作出明确规定，因此仔细阅读条款很有必要。

segments.src: Forwarders also tend to offer related services: consolidating small shipments into shared containers, arranging cargo insurance, preparing documents, and coordinating with customs brokers.
segments.tr: 货运代理通常还提供相关服务：拼箱整合小批量货物、安排货物保险、准备单证以及与报关经纪人协调。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活中的例子

segments.src: Picture Maya, who owns a small furniture store in **Columbus, Ohio**.
segments.tr: 设想一下Maya，她在**美国俄亥俄州哥伦布市**经营一家小型家具店。

segments.src: She orders a 40-foot container of wooden dining sets from a manufacturer near **Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam**.
segments.tr: 她向**越南胡志明市**附近的一家制造商订购了一个40英尺集装箱的实木餐桌椅。

segments.src: Columbus has no seaport, and Maya has no time to manage four carriers.
segments.tr: 哥伦布没有海港，而Maya也没有时间协调四家承运人。

segments.src: So she hires a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: 因此她聘请了一家货运代理。

segments.src: Here's the journey:
segments.tr: 运输路线如下：

segments.src: 1. **Truck:** Factory → Cat Lai port in Ho Chi Minh City
segments.tr: 1. **卡车：** 工厂 → 胡志明市的Cat Lai港

segments.src: 2. **Ship:** Vietnam → Port of Los Angeles / Long Beach
segments.tr: 2. **船舶：** 越南 → 洛杉矶/长滩港

segments.src: 3. **Rail:** Southern California → an inland rail ramp in the Midwest
segments.tr: 3. **铁路：** 南加州 → 中西部的内陆铁路中转场

segments.src: 4. **Truck:** Rail ramp → Maya's warehouse in Columbus
segments.tr: 4. **卡车：** 铁路中转场 → Maya在哥伦布的仓库

segments.src: The forwarder, acting as an NVOCC, issues **one bill of lading covering "place of receipt: factory" to "place of delivery: Columbus."** Maya pays one freight bill in U.S.
segments.tr: 货运代理以无船承运人的身份签发**一份提单，涵盖从“接收地：工厂”到“交付地：哥伦布”的全程。** Maya需支付一张美元运费账单，

segments.src: dollars, say a quoted all-in rate for the container, and deals with one point of contact.
segments.tr: 例如该集装箱的一口价报价，并且只需与一位联系人打交道。

segments.src: If a few chairs arrive cracked, she starts her claim with the forwarder instead of trying to figure out whether the ship, the train, or the truck caused it.
segments.tr: 如果几把椅子到货时破损，她会直接向货运代理提出索赔，而不必去判断究竟是船、火车还是卡车造成的。

segments.src: Customs clearance is a separate job handled by a **licensed customs broker**.
segments.tr: 清关是另一项工作，由**持牌报关经纪人**负责。

segments.src: Many forwarders have one in-house or work with one as a partner.
segments.tr: 许多货运代理内部设有报关人员，或与报关经纪人合作。

segments.src: In the U.S., NVOCCs are licensed or registered by the **Federal Maritime Commission (FMC)**.
segments.tr: 在美国，无船承运人由**美国联邦海事委员会（FMC）**发证或登记。

segments.src: Customs brokers are licensed by **U.S.
segments.tr: 报关经纪人由**美国

segments.src: Customs and Border Protection (CBP)**.
segments.tr: 海关与边境保护局（CBP）**发证。

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 三句话总结

segments.src: - **Multimodal transport** uses two or more modes (truck, ship, rail, air) under **one contract** with **one responsible operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: - **多式联运**使用两种或以上运输方式（卡车、船舶、铁路、航空），由**一份合同**与**一名负责的经营人（MTO）**承担。

segments.src: - A **multimodal transport document** (e.g., FIATA FBL) can cover cargo door to door and, when negotiable, works as a receipt, contract evidence, and document of title.
segments.tr: - **多式联运单据**（例如FIATA FBL）可以覆盖门到门的货运；在可转让的情况下，它同时起到收据、合同证明和物权凭证的作用。

segments.src: - A **freight forwarder** may act as an **agent** (arranging transport for you) or as a **principal/NVOCC** (taking carrier responsibility), and that role decides who is liable.
segments.tr: - **货运代理**可以作为**代理人**（为您安排运输）或**委托人/无船承运人**（承担承运人责任），其角色决定了由谁承担责任。

segments.tr: ## ✅ 自测题

segments.tr: **Q1.** 什么定义了多式联运？

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 今日术语

segments.src: - **Multimodal Transport:** Moving goods by two or more modes of transport under one contract.
segments.tr: - **多式联运：** 在一份合同下，使用两种或以上运输方式运送货物。

segments.src: - **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO):** The party that signs the multimodal contract and takes responsibility for the entire journey.
segments.tr: - **多式联运经营人（MTO）：** 签订多式联运合同并对整个运程承担责任的一方。

segments.src: - **Multimodal (Combined) Transport Bill of Lading:** A transport document covering the whole multimodal route, often from inland origin to inland destination.
segments.tr: - **多式联运（联合运输）提单：** 涵盖整个多式联运路线的运输单据，通常从内陆起运地到内陆目的地。

segments.src: - **Freight Forwarder:** A logistics intermediary that arranges shipments and related services, acting as either an agent or a principal.
segments.tr: - **货运代理：** 安排货运及相关服务的物流中介，可作为代理人或委托人行事。

segments.src: - **NVOCC:** A company that acts as an ocean carrier toward shippers, issuing its own bills of lading, without operating vessels.
segments.tr: - **无船承运人（NVOCC）：** 对托运人以承运人身份行事、签发自己提单、但不经营船舶的公司。

segments.tr: *答案：Q1 – B。

segments.src: What makes it "multimodal" is the mix of modes under a single contract, not the type of container or the number of countries.
segments.tr: 使其成为“多式联运”的是单一合同下的多种运输方式组合，而非集装箱类型或涉及的国家数量。

segments.tr: Q3 – C。

hi.title: [अंतरराष्ट्रीय लॉजिस्टिक्स #10] एक अनुबंध, चार वाहन: फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डर आपका माल दरवाज़े से दरवाज़े तक कैसे पहुँचाते हैं

segments.src: > When cargo travels by truck, ship, and train, multimodal transport lets one company take responsibility for the whole trip under one contract and one transport document. Freight forwarders usually organize that trip.
segments.tr: > जब माल ट्रक, जहाज़ और रेल से होकर जाता है, तब बहुविधा परिवहन (multimodal transport) एक ही कंपनी को एक ही अनुबंध और एक ही परिवहन दस्तावेज़ के तहत पूरी यात्रा की ज़िम्मेदारी लेने देता है। आमतौर पर फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डर (freight forwarder) इस यात्रा को व्यवस्थित करता है।

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## आज की अवधारणा

segments.src: Most international shipments don't travel by just one vehicle.
segments.tr: अधिकतर अंतरराष्ट्रीय शिपमेंट केवल एक ही वाहन से नहीं जाते।

segments.src: A container might leave a factory on a truck, cross an ocean on a ship, move inland by train, and reach its destination on another truck.
segments.tr: एक कंटेनर किसी फ़ैक्ट्री से ट्रक पर निकल सकता है, समुद्र पार जहाज़ से जा सकता है, अंदरूनी इलाके तक रेल से पहुँच सकता है, और अपने गंतव्य तक दूसरे ट्रक से पहुँच सकता है।

segments.src: This is called **multimodal transport** (also called *combined* or *intermodal* transport): moving goods by **at least two different modes of transport under a single contract**.
segments.tr: इसे **बहुविधा परिवहन** (multimodal transport) कहा जाता है (इसे *संयुक्त* या *अंतरमाध्यमिक* (intermodal) परिवहन भी कहते हैं): **एक ही अनुबंध के तहत कम से कम दो अलग-अलग परिवहन माध्यमों** से माल ले जाना।

segments.src: That last part is what matters.
segments.tr: सबसे अहम बात यही आखिरी हिस्सा है।

segments.src: Without it, a shipper would have to sign separate contracts with a trucking company, an ocean carrier, a railroad, and a local delivery firm.
segments.tr: इसके बिना, शिपर (माल भेजने वाले) को ट्रकिंग कंपनी, समुद्री कैरियर, रेलवे और स्थानीय डिलीवरी फ़र्म के साथ अलग-अलग अनुबंध करने होते।

segments.src: Then, if something went wrong, they would have to work out which company was responsible.
segments.tr: फिर अगर कुछ गड़बड़ होती, तो उन्हें यह तय करना पड़ता कि ज़िम्मेदार कौन है।

segments.src: Multimodal transport replaces that patchwork with **one party responsible for the whole journey**: the **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: बहुविधा परिवहन इस बिखरी व्यवस्था की जगह **पूरी यात्रा के लिए एक ही ज़िम्मेदार पक्ष** रखता है: **बहुविधा परिवहन ऑपरेटर (Multimodal Transport Operator — MTO)**।

segments.src: The MTO issues a **multimodal (or combined) transport document**, often in the form of a bill of lading.
segments.tr: MTO **बहुविधा (या संयुक्त) परिवहन दस्तावेज़** जारी करता है, जो अक्सर बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग (bill of lading) के रूप में होता है।

segments.src: A well-known standard version is the **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, published by the international federation of freight forwarders.
segments.tr: एक प्रसिद्ध मानक रूप **FIATA बहुविधा परिवहन बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग (FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading — FBL)** है, जिसे फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डरों के अंतरराष्ट्रीय संघ ने प्रकाशित किया है।

segments.src: Like an ordinary ocean bill of lading, it can serve as:
segments.tr: साधारण समुद्री बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग की तरह, यह इनके रूप में काम कर सकता है:

segments.src: 1. **A receipt** showing that the goods were taken in charge,
segments.tr: 1. **रसीद**, जो दर्शाती है कि माल अपने कब्ज़े में ले लिया गया है,

segments.src: 2. **Evidence of the contract** of carriage, and
segments.tr: 2. **माल ढुलाई अनुबंध का प्रमाण**, और

segments.src: 3. In its negotiable form, **a document of title**, which banks rely on in trade finance such as letters of credit.
segments.tr: 3. इसके परक्राम्य (negotiable) रूप में, **स्वामित्व-पत्र (document of title)**, जिस पर बैंक letter of credit जैसे व्यापार वित्त में भरोसा करते हैं।

segments.src: The main difference is coverage.
segments.tr: मुख्य अंतर कवरेज का है।

segments.src: An ocean bill of lading usually runs from port to port.
segments.tr: समुद्री बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग आमतौर पर पोर्ट से पोर्ट तक चलता है।

segments.src: A multimodal document can run from the **place of receipt** (say, an inland factory) to the **place of delivery** (say, an inland warehouse).
segments.tr: बहुविधा दस्तावेज़ **माल प्राप्ति स्थान** (जैसे अंदरूनी फ़ैक्ट्री) से **डिलीवरी स्थान** (जैसे अंदरूनी गोदाम) तक चल सकता है।

segments.src: So who acts as the MTO?
segments.tr: तो MTO कौन बनता है?

segments.src: Often it's a **freight forwarder**.
segments.tr: अक्सर यह एक **फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डर** होता है।

segments.src: A forwarder is a logistics specialist that arranges shipments for customers.
segments.tr: फ़ॉरवर्डर एक लॉजिस्टिक्स विशेषज्ञ है जो ग्राहकों के लिए शिपमेंट की व्यवस्था करता है।

segments.src: Forwarders can play two different roles:
segments.tr: फ़ॉरवर्डर दो अलग भूमिकाएँ निभा सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **As an agent:** The forwarder books space with carriers *on your behalf*. It handles paperwork and coordination, but the carriers remain responsible for the actual transport.
segments.tr: - **एजेंट के रूप में:** फ़ॉरवर्डर आपकी *ओर से* कैरियरों के साथ जगह बुक करता है। यह कागज़ी कार्य और समन्वय संभालता है, लेकिन असली परिवहन की ज़िम्मेदारी कैरियर की ही रहती है।

segments.src: - **As a principal (carrier):** The forwarder issues its *own* transport document and takes on carrier-style responsibility, even though it may not own a single ship or truck. In U.S. ocean shipping, this kind of company is called an **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).
segments.tr: - **प्रिंसिपल (कैरियर) के रूप में:** फ़ॉरवर्डर अपना *खुद का* परिवहन दस्तावेज़ जारी करता है और कैरियर जैसी ज़िम्मेदारी लेता है, भले ही उसके पास एक भी जहाज़ या ट्रक न हो। अमेरिकी समुद्री व्यापार में ऐसी कंपनी को **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier — गैर-जहाज़-संचालक सामान्य कैरियर) कहा जाता है।

segments.src: This difference has real consequences.
segments.tr: इस अंतर के वास्तविक परिणाम होते हैं।

segments.src: If cargo is damaged, the role the forwarder played determines who you file a claim against.
segments.tr: अगर माल क्षतिग्रस्त हो जाए, तो फ़ॉरवर्डर ने जो भूमिका निभाई थी, वही तय करती है कि दावा किसके खिलाफ़ दर्ज करना है।

segments.src: In practice, an MTO's liability can also depend on *where* the damage happened, because the rules for the ocean leg and the trucking leg may differ.
segments.tr: व्यवहार में, MTO की देनदारी इस पर भी निर्भर कर सकती है कि नुकसान *कहाँ* हुआ, क्योंकि समुद्री हिस्से और ट्रकिंग हिस्से के नियम अलग हो सकते हैं।

segments.src: Contracts spell this out, so it pays to read the terms.
segments.tr: अनुबंध इसे साफ़ लिखते हैं, इसलिए शर्तें ध्यान से पढ़ना फ़ायदेमंद है।

segments.src: Forwarders also tend to offer related services: consolidating small shipments into shared containers, arranging cargo insurance, preparing documents, and coordinating with customs brokers.
segments.tr: फ़ॉरवर्डर संबंधित सेवाएँ भी देते हैं: छोटे शिपमेंट को साझा कंटेनरों में समेकित करना (consolidation), माल बीमा कराना, दस्तावेज़ तैयार करना, और कस्टम ब्रोकरों के साथ समन्वय करना।

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## रोज़मर्रा की ज़िंदगी में

segments.src: Picture Maya, who owns a small furniture store in **Columbus, Ohio**.
segments.tr: कल्पना कीजिए माया की, जिसका **ओहायो के कोलंबस** में एक छोटा फ़र्नीचर स्टोर है।

segments.src: She orders a 40-foot container of wooden dining sets from a manufacturer near **Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam**.
segments.tr: वह **वियतनाम के हो ची मिन्ह सिटी** के पास एक निर्माता से लकड़ी के डाइनिंग सेट वाला 40-फ़ुट कंटेनर मँगवाती है।

segments.src: Columbus has no seaport, and Maya has no time to manage four carriers.
segments.tr: कोलंबस में कोई समुद्री बंदरगाह नहीं है, और माया के पास चार कैरियरों को संभालने का समय नहीं है।

segments.src: So she hires a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: इसलिए वह एक फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डर किराए पर लेती है।

segments.src: Here's the journey:
segments.tr: यह रहा सफ़र:

segments.src: 1. **Truck:** Factory → Cat Lai port in Ho Chi Minh City
segments.tr: 1. **ट्रक:** फ़ैक्ट्री → हो ची मिन्ह सिटी का Cat Lai बंदरगाह

segments.src: 2. **Ship:** Vietnam → Port of Los Angeles / Long Beach
segments.tr: 2. **जहाज़:** वियतनाम → लॉस एंजिल्स / लॉन्ग बीच बंदरगाह

segments.src: 3. **Rail:** Southern California → an inland rail ramp in the Midwest
segments.tr: 3. **रेल:** दक्षिणी कैलिफ़ोर्निया → मिडवेस्ट में एक अंदरूनी रेल रैंप

segments.src: 4. **Truck:** Rail ramp → Maya's warehouse in Columbus
segments.tr: 4. **ट्रक:** रेल रैंप → कोलंबस में माया का गोदाम

segments.src: The forwarder, acting as an NVOCC, issues **one bill of lading covering "place of receipt: factory" to "place of delivery: Columbus."** Maya pays one freight bill in U.S.
segments.tr: फ़ॉरवर्डर, NVOCC के रूप में काम करते हुए, **एक ही बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग जारी करता है, जो "माल प्राप्ति स्थान: फ़ैक्ट्री" से "डिलीवरी स्थान: कोलंबस" तक को कवर करता है।** माया एक ही फ़्रेट बिल अमेरिकी

segments.src: dollars, say a quoted all-in rate for the container, and deals with one point of contact.
segments.tr: डॉलर में चुकाती है, मान लीजिए कंटेनर के लिए बताई गई सारी-शामिल दर, और उसे संपर्क का एक ही व्यक्ति मिलता है।

segments.src: If a few chairs arrive cracked, she starts her claim with the forwarder instead of trying to figure out whether the ship, the train, or the truck caused it.
segments.tr: अगर कुछ कुर्सियाँ टूटी हुई पहुँचें, तो वह दावा फ़ॉरवर्डर के पास शुरू करती है, इसके बजाय यह सोचने के कि जहाज़, रेल या ट्रक में से किसने नुकसान किया।

segments.src: Customs clearance is a separate job handled by a **licensed customs broker**.
segments.tr: सीमा शुल्क निकासी (customs clearance) एक अलग काम है, जिसे **लाइसेंसधारी सीमा शुल्क ब्रोकर** संभालता है।

segments.src: Many forwarders have one in-house or work with one as a partner.
segments.tr: कई फ़ॉरवर्डर के पास अपना ब्रोकर होता है, या वे किसी ब्रोकर के साथ साझेदारी में काम करते हैं।

segments.src: In the U.S., NVOCCs are licensed or registered by the **Federal Maritime Commission (FMC)**.
segments.tr: अमेरिका में NVOCC को **संघीय समुद्री आयोग (Federal Maritime Commission — FMC)** लाइसेंस या पंजीकृत करता है।

segments.src: Customs brokers are licensed by **U.S.
segments.tr: सीमा शुल्क ब्रोकरों को **अमेरिकी

segments.src: Customs and Border Protection (CBP)**.
segments.tr: सीमा शुल्क और सीमा सुरक्षा (U.S. Customs and Border Protection — CBP)** लाइसेंस देता है।

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
- **Multimodal transport** uses two or more modes (truck, ship, rail, air) under **one contract** with **one responsible operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: - **बहुविधा परिवहन** **एक ज़िम्मेदार ऑपरेटर (MTO)** के साथ **एक अनुबंध** के तहत दो या अधिक माध्यमों (ट्रक, जहाज़, रेल, हवाई) का उपयोग करता है।

segments.src: - A **multimodal transport document** (e.g., FIATA FBL) can cover cargo door to door and, when negotiable, works as a receipt, contract evidence, and document of title.
segments.tr: - **बहुविधा परिवहन दस्तावेज़** (जैसे FIATA FBL) माल को दरवाज़े से दरवाज़े तक कवर कर सकता है, और परक्राम्य होने पर रसीद, अनुबंध के प्रमाण और स्वामित्व-पत्र के रूप में काम करता है।

segments.src: - A **freight forwarder** may act as an **agent** (arranging transport for you) or as a **principal/NVOCC** (taking carrier responsibility), and that role decides who is liable.
segments.tr: - **फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डर** **एजेंट** (आपकी ओर से परिवहन की व्यवस्था करना) या **प्रिंसिपल/NVOCC** (कैरियर की ज़िम्मेदारी लेना) के रूप में काम कर सकता है, और यही भूमिका तय करती है कि देनदारी किसकी है।

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 आज के शब्द

segments.src: - **Multimodal Transport:** Moving goods by two or more modes of transport under one contract.
segments.tr: - **बहुविधा परिवहन:** एक ही अनुबंध के तहत दो या अधिक परिवहन माध्यमों से माल ले जाना।

segments.src: - **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO):** The party that signs the multimodal contract and takes responsibility for the entire journey.
segments.tr: - **बहुविधा परिवहन ऑपरेटर (MTO):** वह पक्ष जो बहुविधा अनुबंध पर हस्ताक्षर करता है और पूरी यात्रा की ज़िम्मेदारी लेता है।

segments.src: - **Multimodal (Combined) Transport Bill of Lading:** A transport document covering the whole multimodal route, often from inland origin to inland destination.
segments.tr: - **बहुविधा (संयुक्त) परिवहन बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग:** पूरे बहुविधा मार्ग को कवर करने वाला परिवहन दस्तावेज़, जो अक्सर अंदरूनी उद्गम स्थान से अंदरूनी गंतव्य तक होता है।

segments.src: - **Freight Forwarder:** A logistics intermediary that arranges shipments and related services, acting as either an agent or a principal.
segments.tr: - **फ़्रेट फ़ॉरवर्डर:** एक लॉजिस्टिक्स मध्यस्थ जो शिपमेंट और संबंधित सेवाओं की व्यवस्था करता है, और एजेंट या प्रिंसिपल, दोनों में से किसी एक के रूप में काम कर सकता है।

segments.src: - **NVOCC:** A company that acts as an ocean carrier toward shippers, issuing its own bills of lading, without operating vessels.
segments.tr: - **NVOCC:** वह कंपनी जो शिपर्स के सामने समुद्री कैरियर की तरह काम करती है, अपने खुद के बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग जारी करती है, और जहाज़ नहीं चलाती।

segments.src: *Answers: Q1 – B.
segments.tr: *उत्तर: प्र1 – B।

segments.src: What makes it "multimodal" is the mix of modes under a single contract, not the type of container or the number of countries.
segments.tr: "बहुविधा" इसे इसलिए कहते हैं क्योंकि एक ही अनुबंध के तहत अलग-अलग माध्यमों का मेल होता है, न कि कंटेनर के प्रकार या देशों की संख्या के कारण।

segments.src: Q2 – False.
segments.tr: प्र2 – गलत।

segments.src: NVOCCs issue their own bills of lading and take carrier responsibility without operating any vessels; they buy space from vessel operators.
segments.tr: NVOCC बिना कोई जहाज़ चलाए अपने बिल ऑफ़ लेडिंग जारी करते हैं और कैरियर की ज़िम्मेदारी लेते हैं; वे जगह पोत-संचालकों से खरीदते हैं।

segments.src: Q3 – C.
segments.tr: प्र3 – C।

segments.src: Arranging transport on the shipper's behalf without taking carrier responsibility is the agent role.
segments.tr: शिपर की ओर से परिवहन की व्यवस्था करना, बिना कैरियर की ज़िम्मेदारी लिए, एजेंट की भूमिका है।

segments.src: Customs brokers handle customs clearance, which is a separate function.*
segments.tr: सीमा शुल्क ब्रोकर सीमा शुल्क निकासी संभालते हैं, जो एक अलग कार्य है।*

es.title: [Logística internacional #10] Un contrato, cuatro vehículos: cómo los agentes de carga mueven tu mercancía de puerta a puerta

segments.src: > When cargo travels by truck, ship, and train, multimodal transport lets one company take responsibility for the whole trip under one contract and one transport document. Freight forwarders usually organize that trip.
segments.tr: > Cuando la carga viaja en camión, barco y tren, el transporte multimodal permite que una sola empresa asuma la responsabilidad de todo el trayecto con un solo contrato y un solo documento de transporte. Normalmente, los agentes de carga (*freight forwarders*) organizan ese trayecto.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concepto de hoy

segments.src: Most international shipments don't travel by just one vehicle.
segments.tr: La mayoría de los envíos internacionales no viajan en un solo vehículo.

segments.src: A container might leave a factory on a truck, cross an ocean on a ship, move inland by train, and reach its destination on another truck.
segments.tr: Un contenedor puede salir de una fábrica en camión, cruzar el océano en barco, trasladarse tierra adentro en tren y llegar a su destino en otro camión.

segments.src: This is called **multimodal transport** (also called *combined* or *intermodal* transport): moving goods by **at least two different modes of transport under a single contract**.
segments.tr: Esto se denomina **transporte multimodal** (también llamado transporte *combinado* o *intermodal*): mover mercancías mediante **al menos dos modos de transporte diferentes bajo un único contrato**.

segments.src: That last part is what matters.
segments.tr: Esa última parte es la clave.

segments.src: Without it, a shipper would have to sign separate contracts with a trucking company, an ocean carrier, a railroad, and a local delivery firm.
segments.tr: Sin ella, el cargador tendría que firmar contratos separados con una empresa de transporte por carretera, una naviera, una compañía ferroviaria y una empresa local de reparto.

segments.src: Then, if something went wrong, they would have to work out which company was responsible.
segments.tr: Luego, si algo salía mal, tendría que averiguar qué empresa era la responsable.

segments.src: Multimodal transport replaces that patchwork with **one party responsible for the whole journey**: the **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: El transporte multimodal reemplaza ese esquema fragmentado por **una sola parte responsable de todo el trayecto**: el **Operador de Transporte Multimodal (OTM)**.

segments.src: The MTO issues a **multimodal (or combined) transport document**, often in the form of a bill of lading.
segments.tr: El OTM emite un **documento de transporte multimodal (o combinado)**, que suele adoptar la forma de un conocimiento de embarque.

segments.src: A well-known standard version is the **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, published by the international federation of freight forwarders.
segments.tr: Una versión estándar muy conocida es el **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, publicado por la federación internacional de agentes de carga (FIATA).

segments.src: Like an ordinary ocean bill of lading, it can serve as:
segments.tr: Al igual que un conocimiento de embarque marítimo ordinario, puede servir como:

segments.src: 1. **A receipt** showing that the goods were taken in charge,
segments.tr: 1. **Recibo** que acredita que las mercancías fueron recibidas bajo custodia,

segments.src: 2. **Evidence of the contract** of carriage, and
segments.tr: 2. **Prueba del contrato** de transporte, y

segments.src: 3. In its negotiable form, **a document of title**, which banks rely on in trade finance such as letters of credit.
segments.tr: 3. En su forma negociable, **un título de propiedad sobre la mercancía**, en el que los bancos se apoyan en la financiación comercial, como las cartas de crédito.

segments.src: The main difference is coverage.
segments.tr: La principal diferencia está en la cobertura.

segments.src: An ocean bill of lading usually runs from port to port.
segments.tr: Un conocimiento de embarque marítimo normalmente abarca de puerto a puerto.

segments.src: A multimodal document can run from the **place of receipt** (say, an inland factory) to the **place of delivery** (say, an inland warehouse).
segments.tr: Un documento multimodal puede abarcar desde el **lugar de recepción** (por ejemplo, una fábrica en el interior) hasta el **lugar de entrega** (por ejemplo, un almacén en el interior).

segments.src: So who acts as the MTO?
segments.tr: Entonces, ¿quién actúa como OTM?

segments.src: Often it's a **freight forwarder**.
segments.tr: Con frecuencia, es un **agente de carga**.

segments.src: A forwarder is a logistics specialist that arranges shipments for customers.
segments.tr: Un agente de carga es un especialista en logística que organiza los envíos de sus clientes.

segments.src: Forwarders can play two different roles:
segments.tr: Los agentes de carga pueden desempeñar dos funciones distintas:

segments.src: - **As an agent:** The forwarder books space with carriers *on your behalf*. It handles paperwork and coordination, but the carriers remain responsible for the actual transport.
segments.tr: - **Como agente:** El agente de carga reserva espacio con los transportistas *en nombre del cliente*. Se encarga de la documentación y la coordinación, pero los transportistas siguen siendo responsables del transporte en sí.

segments.src: - **As a principal (carrier):** The forwarder issues its *own* transport document and takes on carrier-style responsibility, even though it may not own a single ship or truck. In U.S. ocean shipping, this kind of company is called an **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).
segments.tr: - **Como principal (transportista):** El agente de carga emite su *propio* documento de transporte y asume una responsabilidad propia de transportista, aunque quizá no sea dueño de ningún barco ni camión. En el transporte marítimo de Estados Unidos, este tipo de empresa se denomina **NVOCC** (*Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier*, transportista común sin buque).

segments.src: This difference has real consequences.
segments.tr: Esta diferencia tiene consecuencias reales.

segments.src: If cargo is damaged, the role the forwarder played determines who you file a claim against.
segments.tr: Si la carga sufre daños, el papel que desempeñó el agente de carga determina contra quién debe presentar la reclamación.

segments.src: In practice, an MTO's liability can also depend on *where* the damage happened, because the rules for the ocean leg and the trucking leg may differ.

segments.src: - **Multimodal Transport:** Moving goods by two or more modes of transport under one contract.

segments.src: - **Freight Forwarder:** A logistics intermediary that arranges shipments and related services, acting as either an agent or a principal.

segments.src: - **NVOCC:** A company that acts as an ocean carrier toward shippers, issuing its own bills of lading, without operating vessels.
segments.tr: - **NVOCC:** Empresa que actúa como transportista marítimo frente a los cargadores, emite sus propios conocimientos de embarque y no opera buques.

ar.title: [الخدمات اللوجستية الدولية #10] عقد واحد، أربع وسائل نقل: كيف ينقل وكلاء الشحن بضائعك من الباب إلى الباب

segments.src: > When cargo travels by truck, ship, and train, multimodal transport lets one company take responsibility for the whole trip under one contract and one transport document. Freight forwarders usually organize that trip.
segments.tr: > عندما تنتقل البضائع بالشاحنة والسفينة والقطار، يتيح النقل متعدد الوسائط لشركة واحدة أن تتحمل مسؤولية الرحلة كاملة بموجب عقد واحد ومستند نقل واحد. وعادةً ما ينظّم وكلاء الشحن هذه الرحلة.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## مفهوم اليوم

segments.src: Most international shipments don't travel by just one vehicle.
segments.tr: لا تنتقل معظم الشحنات الدولية بوسيلة نقل واحدة فقط.

segments.src: A container might leave a factory on a truck, cross an ocean on a ship, move inland by train, and reach its destination on another truck.
segments.tr: قد تغادر الحاوية المصنع على متن شاحنة، وتعبر المحيط على متن سفينة، وتنتقل إلى الداخل بالقطار، ثم تصل إلى وجهتها على شاحنة أخرى.

segments.src: This is called **multimodal transport** (also called *combined* or *intermodal* transport): moving goods by **at least two different modes of transport under a single contract**.
segments.tr: ويُسمّى ذلك **النقل متعدد الوسائط** (ويُعرف أيضًا بالنقل *المركّب* أو *المتعدد الوسائط*): وهو نقل البضائع بـ**وسيلتين مختلفتين على الأقل من وسائل النقل بموجب عقد واحد**.

segments.src: That last part is what matters.
segments.tr: وهذا الجزء الأخير هو الأهم.

segments.src: Without it, a shipper would have to sign separate contracts with a trucking company, an ocean carrier, a railroad, and a local delivery firm.
segments.tr: ومن دونه، سيتعين على الشاحن توقيع عقود منفصلة مع شركة نقل بري، وناقل بحري، وشركة سكك حديدية، وشركة توصيل محلية.

segments.src: Then, if something went wrong, they would have to work out which company was responsible.
segments.tr: ثم، إذا حدث خلل ما، فسيتعين عليه تحديد الشركة المسؤولة.

segments.src: Multimodal transport replaces that patchwork with **one party responsible for the whole journey**: the **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: يحلّ النقل متعدد الوسائط محل هذا التشتت بـ**طرف واحد مسؤول عن الرحلة كاملة**: وهو **مشغّل النقل متعدد الوسائط (MTO)**.

segments.src: The MTO issues a **multimodal (or combined) transport document**, often in the form of a bill of lading.
segments.tr: يُصدر مشغّل النقل متعدد الوسائط **مستند نقل متعدد الوسائط (أو مركّب)**، وغالبًا ما يكون على شكل بوليصة شحن.

segments.src: A well-known standard version is the **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, published by the international federation of freight forwarders.
segments.tr: ومن أشهر النسخ القياسية **بوليصة شحن النقل متعدد الوسائط الصادرة عن FIATA (FBL)**، التي تنشرها الاتحاد الدولي لجمعيات وكلاء الشحن.

segments.src: Like an ordinary ocean bill of lading, it can serve as:
segments.tr: وكما هو الحال في بوليصة الشحن البحري العادية، يمكن أن تُستخدم بوصفها:

segments.src: 1. **A receipt** showing that the goods were taken in charge,
segments.tr: 1. **إيصالًا** يثبت استلام البضائع،

segments.src: 2. **Evidence of the contract** of carriage, and
segments.tr: 2. **دليلًا على عقد النقل**، و

segments.src: 3. In its negotiable form, **a document of title**, which banks rely on in trade finance such as letters of credit.
segments.tr: 3. وفي صيغتها القابلة للتداول، **مستندًا لملكية البضاعة**، تعتمد عليه البنوك في تمويل التجارة مثل خطابات الاعتماد.

segments.src: The main difference is coverage.
segments.tr: والفرق الرئيسي يكمن في نطاق التغطية.

segments.src: An ocean bill of lading usually runs from port to port.
segments.tr: وعادةً ما تغطي بوليصة الشحن البحري المسافة من ميناء إلى ميناء.

segments.src: A multimodal document can run from the **place of receipt** (say, an inland factory) to the **place of delivery** (say, an inland warehouse).
segments.tr: أما المستند متعدد الوسائط فيمكن أن يغطي الرحلة من **مكان الاستلام** (مثلًا، مصنع داخلي) إلى **مكان التسليم** (مثلًا، مستودع داخلي).

segments.src: So who acts as the MTO?
segments.tr: إذن، من يتولى دور مشغّل النقل متعدد الوسائط؟

segments.src: Often it's a **freight forwarder**.
segments.tr: غالبًا ما يكون **وكيل الشحن**.

segments.src: A forwarder is a logistics specialist that arranges shipments for customers.
segments.tr: وكيل الشحن متخصص في الخدمات اللوجستية يرتّب شحنات العملاء.

segments.src: Forwarders can play two different roles:
segments.tr: ويمكن لوكيل الشحن أن يؤدي دورين مختلفين:

segments.src: - **As an agent:** The forwarder books space with carriers *on your behalf*. It handles paperwork and coordination, but the carriers remain responsible for the actual transport.
segments.tr: - **بصفته وكيلًا:** يحجز وكيل الشحن المساحة لدى الناقلين *نيابةً عنك*. ويتولى الإجراءات الورقية والتنسيق، لكن الناقلين يظلون مسؤولين عن النقل الفعلي.

segments.src: - **As a principal (carrier):** The forwarder issues its *own* transport document and takes on carrier-style responsibility, even though it may not own a single ship or truck. In U.S. ocean shipping, this kind of company is called an **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).
segments.tr: - **بصفته أصيلًا (ناقلًا):** يُصدر وكيل الشحن مستند النقل *الخاص به* ويتحمل مسؤولية الناقل، حتى وإن لم يمتلك أي سفينة أو شاحنة. وفي الشحن البحري الأمريكي، يُطلق على هذا النوع من الشركات اسم **NVOCC** (ناقل مشترك لا يشغّل سفنًا).

segments.src: This difference has real consequences.
segments.tr: لهذا الفرق نتائج حقيقية.

segments.src: If cargo is damaged, the role the forwarder played determines who you file a claim against.
segments.tr: إذا تعرضت البضاعة للتلف، فإن الدور الذي أداه وكيل الشحن هو ما يحدد الجهة التي تقدّم ضدها المطالبة.

segments.src: In practice, an MTO's liability can also depend on *where* the damage happened, because the rules for the ocean leg and the trucking leg may differ.
segments.tr: وعمليًا، قد تعتمد مسؤولية مشغّل النقل متعدد الوسائط أيضًا على *مكان* وقوع الضرر، لأن القواعد المطبقة على مرحلة النقل البحري ومرحلة النقل البري قد تختلف.

segments.src: Contracts spell this out, so it pays to read the terms.
segments.tr: والعقود توضح ذلك بالتفصيل، لذا يُستحسن قراءة الشروط بعناية.

segments.src: Forwarders also tend to offer related services: consolidating small shipments into shared containers, arranging cargo insurance, preparing documents, and coordinating with customs brokers.
segments.tr: ويميل وكلاء الشحن كذلك إلى تقديم خدمات ذات صلة: تجميع الشحنات الصغيرة في حاويات مشتركة، وترتيب التأمين على البضائع، وإعداد المستندات، والتنسيق مع المخلّصين الجمركيين.

fr.title: [Logistique internationale #10] Un contrat, quatre véhicules : comment les transitaires acheminent vos marchandises de porte à porte

segments.src: > When cargo travels by truck, ship, and train, multimodal transport lets one company take responsibility for the whole trip under one contract and one transport document. Freight forwarders usually organize that trip.
segments.tr: > Quand une marchandise voyage par camion, bateau et train, le transport multimodal permet à une seule entreprise d'assumer la responsabilité de tout le trajet, sous un seul contrat et un seul document de transport. Ce sont généralement les transitaires qui organisent ce trajet.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Concept du jour

segments.src: Most international shipments don't travel by just one vehicle.
segments.tr: La plupart des expéditions internationales ne voyagent pas par un seul moyen de transport.

segments.src: A container might leave a factory on a truck, cross an ocean on a ship, move inland by train, and reach its destination on another truck.
segments.tr: Un conteneur peut quitter une usine sur un camion, traverser l'océan sur un navire, rejoindre l'intérieur des terres par train, puis arriver à destination sur un autre camion.

segments.src: This is called **multimodal transport** (also called *combined* or *intermodal* transport): moving goods by **at least two different modes of transport under a single contract**.
segments.tr: On parle alors de **transport multimodal** (aussi appelé transport *combiné* ou *intermodal*) : l'acheminement de marchandises par **au moins deux modes de transport différents, en vertu d'un contrat unique**.

segments.src: That last part is what matters.
segments.tr: C'est cette dernière partie qui compte.

segments.src: Without it, a shipper would have to sign separate contracts with a trucking company, an ocean carrier, a railroad, and a local delivery firm.
segments.tr: Sans elle, un chargeur devrait signer des contrats distincts avec une entreprise de camionnage, un transporteur maritime, une compagnie ferroviaire et une société de livraison locale.

segments.src: Then, if something went wrong, they would have to work out which company was responsible.
segments.tr: En cas de problème, il lui faudrait ensuite déterminer quelle entreprise est responsable.

segments.src: Multimodal transport replaces that patchwork with **one party responsible for the whole journey**: the **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: Le transport multimodal remplace ce puzzle par **une seule partie responsable de tout le parcours** : l'**opérateur de transport multimodal (OTM)**.

segments.src: The MTO issues a **multimodal (or combined) transport document**, often in the form of a bill of lading.
segments.tr: L'OTM émet un **document de transport multimodal (ou combiné)**, souvent sous la forme d'un connaissement.

segments.src: A well-known standard version is the **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, published by the international federation of freight forwarders.
segments.tr: Une version standard très connue est le **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, publié par la fédération internationale des transitaires.

segments.src: Like an ordinary ocean bill of lading, it can serve as:
segments.tr: Comme un connaissement maritime ordinaire, il peut servir :

segments.src: 1. **A receipt** showing that the goods were taken in charge,
segments.tr: 1. De **reçu** attestant que la marchandise a été prise en charge,

segments.src: 2. **Evidence of the contract** of carriage, and
segments.tr: 2. De **preuve du contrat** de transport, et

segments.src: 3. In its negotiable form, **a document of title**, which banks rely on in trade finance such as letters of credit.
segments.tr: 3. Sous sa forme négociable, de **document de titre**, sur lequel les banques s'appuient dans le financement du commerce, par exemple les lettres de crédit.

segments.src: The main difference is coverage.
segments.tr: La principale différence tient à la couverture.

segments.src: An ocean bill of lading usually runs from port to port.
segments.tr: Un connaissement maritime couvre en général le trajet de port à port.

segments.src: A multimodal document can run from the **place of receipt** (say, an inland factory) to the **place of delivery** (say, an inland warehouse).
segments.tr: Un document multimodal peut couvrir le trajet du **lieu de prise en charge** (par exemple une usine située à l'intérieur des terres) jusqu'au **lieu de livraison** (par exemple un entrepôt à l'intérieur des terres).

segments.src: So who acts as the MTO?
segments.tr: Qui joue alors le rôle d'OTM ?

segments.src: Often it's a **freight forwarder**.
segments.tr: Souvent, il s'agit d'un **transitaire**.

segments.src: A forwarder is a logistics specialist that arranges shipments for customers.
segments.tr: Un transitaire est un spécialiste de la logistique qui organise les expéditions pour ses clients.

segments.src: Forwarders can play two different roles:
segments.tr: Le transitaire peut jouer deux rôles différents :

segments.src: - **As an agent:** The forwarder books space with carriers *on your behalf*. It handles paperwork and coordination, but the carriers remain responsible for the actual transport.
segments.tr: - **En tant qu'agent :** le transitaire réserve de la capacité auprès des transporteurs *pour le compte de son client*. Il gère les formalités et la coordination, mais ce sont les transporteurs qui restent responsables du transport proprement dit.

segments.src: - **As a principal (carrier):** The forwarder issues its *own* transport document and takes on carrier-style responsibility, even though it may not own a single ship or truck. In U.S. ocean shipping, this kind of company is called an **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).
segments.tr: - **En tant que principal (transporteur) :** le transitaire émet *son propre* document de transport et assume la responsabilité d'un transporteur, même s'il ne possède ni navire ni camion. Dans le transport maritime américain, ce type d'entreprise est appelé **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier, transporteur public sans navire).

segments.src: This difference has real consequences.
segments.tr: Cette différence a des conséquences concrètes.

segments.src: If cargo is damaged, the role the forwarder played determines who you file a claim against.
segments.tr: Si la marchandise est endommagée, le rôle joué par le transitaire détermine à qui vous adressez votre réclamation.

segments.src: In practice, an MTO's liability can also depend on *where* the damage happened, because the rules for the ocean leg and the trucking leg may differ.
segments.tr: En pratique, la responsabilité d'un OTM peut aussi dépendre de *l'endroit* où le dommage est survenu, car les règles applicables au tronçon maritime et au tronçon routier peuvent différer.

segments.src: Contracts spell this out, so it pays to read the terms.
segments.tr: Les contrats détaillent ces points, il est donc utile de lire attentivement les conditions.

segments.src: Forwarders also tend to offer related services: consolidating small shipments into shared containers, arranging cargo insurance, preparing documents, and coordinating with customs brokers.
segments.tr: Les transitaires proposent aussi souvent des services connexes : groupage de petites expéditions dans des conteneurs partagés, souscription d'une assurance marchandises, préparation des documents et coordination avec les courtiers en douane.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la vie quotidienne

segments.src: Picture Maya, who owns a small furniture store in **Columbus, Ohio**.
segments.tr: Imaginez Maya, qui possède un petit magasin de meubles à **Columbus, Ohio**.

segments.src: She orders a 40-foot container of wooden dining sets from a manufacturer near **Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam**.
segments.tr: Elle commande à un fabricant situé près de **Hô-Chi-Minh-Ville, Vietnam**, un conteneur de 40 pieds de salles à manger en bois.

segments.src: Columbus has no seaport, and Maya has no time to manage four carriers.
segments.tr: Columbus n'a pas de port maritime, et Maya n'a pas le temps de gérer quatre transporteurs.

segments.src: So she hires a freight forwarder.
segments.tr: Elle fait donc appel à un transitaire.

segments.src: Here's the journey:
segments.tr: Voici le trajet :

segments.src: 1. **Truck:** Factory → Cat Lai port in Ho Chi Minh City
segments.tr: 1. **Camion :** usine → port de Cat Lai à Hô-Chi-Minh-Ville

segments.src: 2. **Ship:** Vietnam → Port of Los Angeles / Long Beach
segments.tr: 2. **Navire :** Vietnam → port de Los Angeles / Long Beach

segments.src: 3. **Rail:** Southern California → an inland rail ramp in the Midwest
segments.tr: 3. **Train :** sud de la Californie → un terminal ferroviaire intérieur dans le Midwest

segments.src: 4. **Truck:** Rail ramp → Maya's warehouse in Columbus
segments.tr: 4. **Camion :** terminal ferroviaire → entrepôt de Maya à Columbus

segments.src: The forwarder, acting as an NVOCC, issues **one bill of lading covering "place of receipt: factory" to "place of delivery: Columbus."** Maya pays one freight bill in U.S.
segments.tr: Le transitaire, agissant en tant que NVOCC, émet **un seul connaissement couvrant le « lieu de prise en charge : usine » jusqu'au « lieu de livraison : Columbus »**. Maya règle une seule facture de fret en

segments.src: dollars, say a quoted all-in rate for the container, and deals with one point of contact.
segments.tr: dollars américains, par exemple un tarif tout compris coté pour le conteneur, et n'a qu'un seul interlocuteur.

segments.src: If a few chairs arrive cracked, she starts her claim with the forwarder instead of trying to figure out whether the ship, the train, or the truck caused it.
segments.tr: Si quelques chaises arrivent fissurées, elle déposera sa réclamation auprès du transitaire, au lieu de chercher à déterminer si ce sont le navire, le train ou le camion qui en sont à l'origine.

segments.src: Customs clearance is a separate job handled by a **licensed customs broker**.
segments.tr: Le dédouanement est une tâche distincte, confiée à un **courtier en douane agréé**.

segments.src: Many forwarders have one in-house or work with one as a partner.
segments.tr: Beaucoup de transitaires disposent d'un courtier en interne ou travaillent avec un partenaire.

segments.src: In the U.S., NVOCCs are licensed or registered by the **Federal Maritime Commission (FMC)**.
segments.tr: Aux États-Unis, les NVOCC sont agréés ou enregistrés par la **Federal Maritime Commission (FMC)**.

segments.src: Customs brokers are licensed by **U.S.
segments.tr: Les courtiers en douane sont agréés par l'**U.S.

segments.src: Customs and Border Protection (CBP)**.
segments.tr: Customs and Border Protection (CBP)**.

segments.src: ## 3-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Résumé en 3 points

segments.src: - **Multimodal transport** uses two or more modes (truck, ship, rail, air) under **one contract** with **one responsible operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: - Le **transport multimodal** combine deux modes ou plus (camion, navire, train, avion) sous **un seul contrat** avec **un seul opérateur responsable (OTM)**.

segments.src: - A **multimodal transport document** (e.g., FIATA FBL) can cover cargo door to door and, when negotiable, works as a receipt, contract evidence, and document of title.
segments.tr: - Un **document de transport multimodal** (par ex. le FIATA FBL) peut couvrir la marchandise de porte à porte et, lorsqu'il est négociable, sert de reçu, de preuve du contrat et de document de titre.

segments.src: - A **freight forwarder** may act as an **agent** (arranging transport for you) or as a **principal/NVOCC** (taking carrier responsibility), and that role decides who is liable.
segments.tr: - Un **transitaire** peut agir comme **agent** (il organise le transport pour vous) ou comme **principal/NVOCC** (il assume la responsabilité du transporteur), et ce rôle détermine qui est responsable.

pt.title: [International Logistics #10] Um contrato, quatro veículos: como os agentes de carga levam suas mercadorias de porta a porta

segments.src: > When cargo travels by truck, ship, and train, multimodal transport lets one company take responsibility for the whole trip under one contract and one transport document. Freight forwarders usually organize that trip.
segments.tr: > Quando a carga viaja por caminhão, navio e trem, o transporte multimodal permite que uma única empresa assuma a responsabilidade por toda a viagem, sob um único contrato e um único documento de transporte. Normalmente, é um agente de carga que organiza essa viagem.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: Most international shipments don't travel by just one vehicle.
segments.tr: A maioria dos embarques internacionais não percorre apenas um tipo de veículo.

segments.src: A container might leave a factory on a truck, cross an ocean on a ship, move inland by train, and reach its destination on another truck.
segments.tr: Um contêiner pode sair de uma fábrica por caminhão, atravessar o oceano em um navio, seguir para o interior por trem e chegar ao destino em outro caminhão.

segments.src: This is called **multimodal transport** (also called *combined* or *intermodal* transport): moving goods by **at least two different modes of transport under a single contract**.
segments.tr: Isso se chama **transporte multimodal** (também chamado de transporte *combinado* ou *intermodal*): a movimentação de mercadorias por **pelo menos dois modais de transporte diferentes sob um único contrato**.

segments.src: That last part is what matters.
segments.tr: Essa última parte é a que importa.

segments.src: Without it, a shipper would have to sign separate contracts with a trucking company, an ocean carrier, a railroad, and a local delivery firm.
segments.tr: Sem ela, o embarcador teria de assinar contratos separados com uma transportadora rodoviária, um armador, uma ferrovia e uma empresa de entrega local.

segments.src: Then, if something went wrong, they would have to work out which company was responsible.
segments.tr: Depois, se algo desse errado, ele teria de descobrir qual empresa era a responsável.

segments.src: Multimodal transport replaces that patchwork with **one party responsible for the whole journey**: the **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: O transporte multimodal substitui esse emaranhado por **uma única parte responsável por toda a viagem**: o **Operador de Transporte Multimodal (OTM)**.

segments.src: The MTO issues a **multimodal (or combined) transport document**, often in the form of a bill of lading.
segments.tr: O OTM emite um **documento de transporte multimodal (ou combinado)**, muitas vezes na forma de conhecimento de embarque.

segments.src: A well-known standard version is the **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, published by the international federation of freight forwarders.
segments.tr: Uma versão padrão bem conhecida é o **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, publicado pela federação internacional de agentes de carga.

segments.src: Like an ordinary ocean bill of lading, it can serve as:
segments.tr: Assim como um conhecimento de embarque marítimo comum, ele pode servir como:

segments.src: 1. **A receipt** showing that the goods were taken in charge,
segments.tr: 1. **Recibo** que comprova que a mercadoria foi recebida sob custódia,

segments.src: 2. **Evidence of the contract** of carriage, and
segments.tr: 2. **Prova do contrato** de transporte, e

segments.src: 3. In its negotiable form, **a document of title**, which banks rely on in trade finance such as letters of credit.
segments.tr: 3. Em sua forma negociável, **título de propriedade**, no qual os bancos se apoiam em operações de financiamento do comércio exterior, como cartas de crédito.

segments.src: The main difference is coverage.
segments.tr: A principal diferença está na cobertura.

segments.src: An ocean bill of lading usually runs from port to port.
segments.tr: Um conhecimento de embarque marítimo geralmente vai de porto a porto.

segments.src: A multimodal document can run from the **place of receipt** (say, an inland factory) to the **place of delivery** (say, an inland warehouse).
segments.tr: Um documento multimodal pode ir do **local de recebimento** (por exemplo, uma fábrica no interior) até o **local de entrega** (por exemplo, um armazém no interior).

segments.src: So who acts as the MTO?
segments.tr: Então, quem atua como OTM?

segments.src: Often it's a **freight forwarder**.
segments.tr: Muitas vezes, é um **agente de carga**.

segments.src: A forwarder is a logistics specialist that arranges shipments for customers.
segments.tr: O agente de carga é um especialista em logística que organiza embarques para clientes.

segments.src: Forwarders can play two different roles:
segments.tr: Os agentes de carga podem desempenhar dois papéis diferentes:

segments.src: - **As an agent:** The forwarder books space with carriers *on your behalf*. It handles paperwork and coordination, but the carriers remain responsible for the actual transport.
segments.tr: - **Como agente:** O agente reserva espaço com transportadoras *em nome do cliente*. Ele cuida da documentação e da coordenação, mas as transportadoras continuam responsáveis pelo transporte em si.

segments.src: - **As a principal (carrier):** The forwarder issues its *own* transport document and takes on carrier-style responsibility, even though it may not own a single ship or truck. In U.S. ocean shipping, this kind of company is called an **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).
segments.tr: - **Como principal (transportador):** O agente emite *seu próprio* documento de transporte e assume a responsabilidade de transportador, mesmo que não possua nenhum navio ou caminhão. No transporte marítimo dos EUA, esse tipo de empresa é chamado de **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).

segments.src: This difference has real consequences.
segments.tr: Essa diferença tem consequências reais.

segments.src: If cargo is damaged, the role the forwarder played determines who you file a claim against.
segments.tr: Se a carga for danificada, o papel que o agente desempenhou determina contra quem você deve abrir a reclamação.

segments.src: In practice, an MTO's liability can also depend on *where* the damage happened, because the rules for the ocean leg and the trucking leg may differ.
segments.tr: Na prática, a responsabilidade de um OTM também pode depender de *onde* o dano ocorreu, porque as regras para o trecho marítimo e para o trecho rodoviário podem ser diferentes.

segments.src: Contracts spell this out, so it pays to read the terms.
segments.tr: Os contratos detalham isso, então vale a pena ler as condições.

segments.src: Forwarders also tend to offer related services: consolidating small shipments into shared containers, arranging cargo insurance, preparing documents, and coordinating with customs brokers.
segments.tr: Os agentes de carga também costumam oferecer serviços relacionados: consolidação de pequenos embarques em contêineres compartilhados, contratação de seguro de carga, preparação de documentos e coordenação com despachantes aduaneiros.

in.title: [International Logistics #10] Satu Kontrak, Empat Moda: Cara Freight Forwarder Mengantarkan Barang Anda dari Pintu ke Pintu

segments.src: > When cargo travels by truck, ship, and train, multimodal transport lets one company take responsibility for the whole trip under one contract and one transport document. Freight forwarders usually organize that trip.
segments.tr: > Ketika kargo diangkut dengan truk, kapal, dan kereta api, transportasi multimoda memungkinkan satu perusahaan bertanggung jawab atas seluruh perjalanan dalam satu kontrak dan satu dokumen angkutan. Freight forwarder biasanya yang mengatur perjalanan tersebut.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Most international shipments don't travel by just one vehicle.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar pengiriman internasional tidak hanya menggunakan satu jenis kendaraan.

segments.src: A container might leave a factory on a truck, cross an ocean on a ship, move inland by train, and reach its destination on another truck.
segments.tr: Sebuah kontainer bisa berangkat dari pabrik dengan truk, menyeberangi laut dengan kapal, bergerak ke daratan dengan kereta api, dan tiba di tujuan dengan truk lain.

segments.src: This is called **multimodal transport** (also called *combined* or *intermodal* transport): moving goods by **at least two different modes of transport under a single contract**.
segments.tr: Ini disebut **transportasi multimoda** (juga disebut *transportasi gabungan* atau *intermodal*): memindahkan barang dengan **setidaknya dua moda transportasi berbeda di bawah satu kontrak**.

segments.src: That last part is what matters.
segments.tr: Bagian terakhir inilah yang penting.

segments.src: Without it, a shipper would have to sign separate contracts with a trucking company, an ocean carrier, a railroad, and a local delivery firm.
segments.tr: Tanpa itu, pengirim harus menandatangani kontrak terpisah dengan perusahaan trucking, perusahaan pelayaran, perusahaan kereta api, dan perusahaan pengiriman lokal.

segments.src: Then, if something went wrong, they would have to work out which company was responsible.
segments.tr: Lalu, jika terjadi masalah, mereka harus mencari tahu perusahaan mana yang bertanggung jawab.

segments.src: Multimodal transport replaces that patchwork with **one party responsible for the whole journey**: the **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.
segments.tr: Transportasi multimoda menggantikan kerumitan itu dengan **satu pihak yang bertanggung jawab atas seluruh perjalanan**: **Multimodal Transport Operator (MTO)**.

segments.src: The MTO issues a **multimodal (or combined) transport document**, often in the form of a bill of lading.
segments.tr: MTO menerbitkan **dokumen transportasi multimoda (atau gabungan)**, sering kali berbentuk bill of lading.

segments.src: A well-known standard version is the **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, published by the international federation of freight forwarders.
segments.tr: Versi standar yang terkenal adalah **FIATA Multimodal Transport Bill of Lading (FBL)**, yang diterbitkan oleh federasi internasional freight forwarder.

segments.src: Like an ordinary ocean bill of lading, it can serve as:
segments.tr: Seperti bill of lading laut biasa, dokumen ini dapat berfungsi sebagai:

segments.src: 1. **A receipt** showing that the goods were taken in charge,
segments.tr: 1. **Tanda terima** yang menunjukkan bahwa barang telah diterima untuk diangkut,

segments.src: 2. **Evidence of the contract** of carriage, and
segments.tr: 2. **Bukti kontrak** pengangkutan, dan

segments.src: 3. In its negotiable form, **a document of title**, which banks rely on in trade finance such as letters of credit.
segments.tr: 3. Dalam bentuk yang dapat dinegosiasikan, **dokumen kepemilikan**, yang diandalkan bank dalam pembiayaan perdagangan seperti letter of credit.

segments.src: The main difference is coverage.
segments.tr: Perbedaan utamanya terletak pada cakupan.

segments.src: An ocean bill of lading usually runs from port to port.
segments.tr: Bill of lading laut biasanya berlaku dari pelabuhan ke pelabuhan.

segments.src: A multimodal document can run from the **place of receipt** (say, an inland factory) to the **place of delivery** (say, an inland warehouse).
segments.tr: Dokumen multimoda dapat berlaku dari **tempat penerimaan** (misalnya, pabrik di daratan) hingga **tempat pengiriman** (misalnya, gudang di daratan).

segments.src: So who acts as the MTO?
segments.tr: Jadi siapa yang bertindak sebagai MTO?

segments.src: Often it's a **freight forwarder**.
segments.tr: Sering kali itu adalah **freight forwarder**.

segments.src: A forwarder is a logistics specialist that arranges shipments for customers.
segments.tr: Forwarder adalah spesialis logistik yang mengatur pengiriman untuk pelanggan.

segments.src: Forwarders can play two different roles:
segments.tr: Forwarder dapat memainkan dua peran berbeda:

segments.src: - **As an agent:** The forwarder books space with carriers *on your behalf*. It handles paperwork and coordination, but the carriers remain responsible for the actual transport.
segments.tr: - **Sebagai agen:** Forwarder memesan ruang dengan carrier *atas nama Anda*. Forwarder menangani dokumen dan koordinasi, tetapi carrier tetap bertanggung jawab atas pengangkutan sebenarnya.

segments.src: - **As a principal (carrier):** The forwarder issues its *own* transport document and takes on carrier-style responsibility, even though it may not own a single ship or truck. In U.S. ocean shipping, this kind of company is called an **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).
segments.tr: - **Sebagai prinsipal (carrier):** Forwarder menerbitkan dokumen angkutan *miliknya sendiri* dan memikul tanggung jawab seperti carrier, meskipun mungkin tidak memiliki satu kapal atau truk pun. Dalam pengiriman laut AS, perusahaan jenis ini disebut **NVOCC** (Non-Vessel-Operating Common Carrier).

segments.src: This difference has real consequences.
segments.tr: Perbedaan ini memiliki konsekuensi nyata.

segments.src: If cargo is damaged, the role the forwarder played determines who you file a claim against.
segments.tr: Jika kargo rusak, peran yang dimainkan forwarder menentukan kepada siapa Anda mengajukan klaim.

segments.src: In practice, an MTO's liability can also depend on *where* the damage happened, because the rules for the ocean leg and the trucking leg may differ.
segments.tr: Dalam praktiknya, tanggung jawab MTO juga dapat bergantung pada *di mana* kerusakan terjadi, karena aturan untuk leg laut dan leg trucking bisa berbeda.

segments.src: Contracts spell this out, so it pays to read the terms.
segments.tr: Kontrak menjabarkan hal ini secara rinci, jadi ada baiknya membaca ketentuannya.

segments.src: Forwarders also tend to offer related services: consolidating small shipments into shared containers, arranging cargo insurance, preparing documents, and coordinating with customs brokers.
segments.tr: Forwarder juga cenderung menawarkan layanan terkait: menggabungkan pengiriman kecil ke dalam kontainer bersama, mengatur asuransi kargo, menyiapkan dokumen, dan berkoordinasi dengan customs broker.
